name: Jin-Gitaxias
description: Jin-Gitaxias is a Phyrexian praetor, scientist and inventor who serves Elesh Norn, and who compleated Tamiyo and built Tezzeret's darksteel body.

summary.text: Jin-Gitaxias is a Phyrexian praetor, scientist and inventor who serves Elesh Norn, and who compleated Tamiyo and built Tezzeret's darksteel body.

bio.text: He joined Elesh Norn's effort to create Atraxa, and is described as the monster who murdered Tameshi.
He led the lab operation on Kamigawa, sending ninjas after Kaito, and the Wanderer cleaved him with her sword while freeing Kaito and Tamiyo from the surgical tables.

timeline.summary: Atraxa, a captured Mirran angel, is compleated by Elesh Norn and the other praetors except Urabrask.
timeline.quote: The praetor Elesh Norn honored the angel's tenacity with the blessed gift of Phyrexian compleation

citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Kaito encounters the monster who murdered Tameshi, who names himself Jin-Gitaxias and calls ninjas.
timeline.quote: The existence of a second Jin-Gitaxias on this plane is highly improbable

citation.work: Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance
citation.text: "Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito fights the Undercity ninjas and escapes the lab with a smoke bomb.
timeline.quote: Black smoke exploded through the crowd

citation.work: Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance
citation.text: "Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The emperor reveals she has visions of the lab and that Jin-Gitaxias told Risona and the Uprisers of her return, so they will attack the palace.
timeline.quote: They plan to attack the palace imminently.

citation.work: Episode 4: The Break-In
citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret appears and tells them the experiments are about testing the connection between body and soul for Phyrexia, thanking them for bringing planeswalkers to the lab.
timeline.quote: And kami are much easier to come by than what Phyrexia really needs."

citation.work: Episode 4: The Break-In
citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer cleaves Jin-Gitaxias with her sword and frees Kaito and Tamiyo from the surgical tables.
timeline.quote: The Wanderer brought her sword down like a blow from the heavens and cleaved Jin-Gitaxias from his neck to his chest.

citation.work: Episode 4: The Break-In
citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer, Kaito and Tamiyo defeat the henchmen in the compound and hold Tezzeret paralyzed; the Wanderer decides to bring him to Kyodai.
timeline.quote: "Yes. We will decide his fate together."

citation.work: Episode 5: Threads of War
citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: In the Phyrexian laboratory Tamiyo awakens Phyrexianized, loyal to Phyrexia and calling it her new family.
timeline.quote: Phyrexia was her new home.

citation.work: Episode 5: Threads of War
citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias announces the first Phyrexianized planeswalker and Tezzeret asks whether Elesh Norn knows.
timeline.quote: Does Elesh Norn know you've succeeded in creating the first Phyrexianized planeswalker?"

citation.work: Episode 5: Threads of War
citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Ixhel uses the Surgical Bay to create a new being from the parts she took, and brings it to Atraxa.
timeline.quote: Except this time, you have made something.

timeline.quote: Send the other to Jin-Gitaxias for reconditioning.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret wakes bound in Jin-Gitaxias's laboratory, where Tamiyo was compleated.
timeline.quote: So it was happening. His reward, finally here.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias melts Tezzeret's etherium arm to bond his spine to the darksteel body.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret watched as the embodiment of his own exceptionalism melted into slag.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret's head and spine are transferred into the darksteel body and he has a vision of a clock and an island of metal.
timeline.quote: Then his head and spine were separated from his body

timeline.quote: There is no violating an agreement already broken.

citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret smashes the tank and the slab through the scrapchief, but Jin-Gitaxias kills it, so Tezzeret planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret planeswalked away.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Elspeth falls through other planes and lands at the Invasion Tree on Mirrodin, which Jin-Gitaxias's army fills.
timeline.quote: The Invasion Tree stands as proud testament to the unending triumphs of Elesh Norn.

timeline.summary: Norn orders Jin-Gitaxias to harvest what is left of Koth's rebellion and he steps toward the prisoners.
timeline.quote: Jin-Gitaxias. Come harvest what is left of Koth's little rebellion.

timeline.summary: Elspeth is reborn with wings and returns to time as Jin-Gitaxias attacks, meeting his claws with her sword.
timeline.quote: She is Elspeth, and she is not.

timeline.summary: Karn, lashed to slag held aloft by Norn's choir, is being taken apart as Norn taunts him.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians have been taking him apart, piece by piece, and repurposing his silver body.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention

timeline.summary: Norn calls Karn the False Patriarch and demands he answer Phyrexia; Jin-Gitaxias raises his claws to strike Karn.
timeline.quote: Jin-Gitaxias raises an arm to strike.

timeline.summary: Elspeth arrives as an angel in golden armor, blocking Jin-Gitaxias's strike and sending his legions into the abyss.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention

timeline.quote: "Dissent is a blasphemy, praetor .

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention

timeline.summary: The sanctum cracks apart as Zhalfir takes New Phyrexia's place, and Norn rails that Phyrexia will never die while her army turns on her.
timeline.quote: "Why aren't any of you protecting me!? I am Phyrexia!"
